title: Glasses with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- glasses frame -->
  <rect x="8" y="34" width="36" height="28" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="3"/>
  <rect x="56" y="34" width="36" height="28" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#FFD54F" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x="44" y="44" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <!-- temples -->
  <rect x="2" y="42" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <rect x="90" y="42" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <!-- lenses -->
  <rect x="13" y="39" width="26" height="18" rx="7" ry="7" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="61" y="39" width="26" height="18" rx="7" ry="7" fill="#B3E5FC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="48" r="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="48" r="4" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="27.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="75.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M 36 62 Q 50 74 64 62" fill="none" stroke="#4FC3F7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="16" cy="58" r="4" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="58" r="4" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
